deployment.environment: WSL2 local; load generator and all services share one host, not a remote server
deployment.application: Java 8u504, Spring Boot 2.7.4, one process on 18081; java -jar target/hmdp-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar
deployment.nginx: 1.18.0 portable Ubuntu binary; 2 workers, worker_connections=2048, upstream keepalive=64; port 18080
deployment.mysql: 8.0.28 portable binary; existing dev data directory on WSL filesystem; port 13306
deployment.redis: 6.2.16 portable binary, AOF enabled, appendfsync everysec, port 16379
deployment.rabbitmq: 3.9.13 portable binary, durable classic queues and persistent messages, port 15672
deployment.application_pools: Hikari default max=10; Redis pool max-active=10; RabbitMQ consumers=2 prefetch=10; Tomcat default max threads=200
deployment.features: USER rate limit enabled 5/10s; close task enabled, payment timeout 900s; confirm timeout 3000ms; recovery age 300000ms
deployment.network: JMeter -> loopback Nginx -> loopback application; no WAN latency
